svg.title: What's inside a LocalOps environment on Google Cloud
svg.text: What's inside a LocalOps environment on Google Cloud
Everything below is provisioned inside your own Google Cloud project. Optional ops.json resources are created only when a service declares them.
one environment = one dedicated VPC network + regional GKE cluster
custom mode · one regional subnet (default or custom CIDR)
private nodes (no public IPs) · Private Google Access on
private IP only, via Private Service Access (VPC peering, reserved /20)
acts as a Google service account
Access is granted to each service
Created on demand from your ops.json
